messages:
nora_sales: LifelineHealth wants a HIPAA POC. They estimate peak ~950 qps (avg ~70 tokens), baseline ~300 qps, bursts last 1-4m. Need reserved sizing, preheat plan, autoscale snippet, and an SLA blurb for the SOW by EOD Friday.

devin_eng: Quick calc: on our prod A100 class with quantized model, ~300 qps per GPU @70 tokens. 950 peak -> recommend reserved_gpus=4 plus burst_pool=1 to cover short spikes.

rachel_sre: Agree. KV shards = GPUs * 2 to reduce hot shards (shards=8). Preheat 15m before expected spike to warm KV and weights. AZ spread across 2 zones.

omar_prod: Add a degraded fallback model (gpt-small-quant) to maintain availability if we lose burst capacity. Route: reserved -> burst -> degraded_shared.

ops_ian: Ops knobs: global_rate_limit:1200qps, queue_max:600. Add auto-shed policy for sustained overload. Preheat example:

redwood preheat --project lifeline-poc --model gpt-med-quant --shards 8 --duration 15m --warm_weights true

devin_eng: Autoscale snippet for the SOW (pasteable):

autoscale:
  reserved_gpus: "4"
  burst_pool: "1"
  preheat_minutes: "15"
  kv_shards: "8"
  scale_up_policy: "target_util:65%, cooldown:20s"
  scale_down_policy: "grace_period:180s"
  fallback_model: "gpt-small-quant"

rachel_sre: For SLA: commit p99 < 220ms when on reserved_gpus=4 with KV warmed and no eviction. Add caveat: serving from burst or degraded model may raise p99 to 350-600ms.

legal_sam: I'll add BAA + KMS and audit logs clauses. Need their security questionnaire PDF. Nora, please forward.

deploy-bot: Preheat placeholder scheduled: lifeline-poc / preheat / 2024-12-12T07:45Z :white_check_mark:

nora_sales: Thanks all. I'll update the quote: reserved_gpus:4, burst_pool:1, preheat:15m, include SLA caveat and ops runbook. Will send the questionnaire to legal.
